function.name: lark_cli
function.description: Lark/Feishu unified CLI. Use for calendar/base/docs/drive/sheets/wiki/mail/im/task/vc/contact/approval/whiteboard/slides/okr/minutes. Output is JSON. If stdout exceeds 8KB it is auto-uploaded to a Lark cloud doc and the doc URL is appended after a truncated head. Pre-authorized via 'lark-cli auth login'. Examples: args=['calendar','+agenda']; args=['wiki','+search','--query','onboarding']; args=['base','records','search','--params','{"app_token":"xxx"}','--jq','.items[0:5]'].

args.description: lark-cli positional args (do not include 'lark-cli' itself)

jq.description: Optional jq filter to shrink JSON output

title.description: Title used for the overflow doc; default 'lark-cli'
